title: Wso2am: pre-authentication attacker could leverage type size/count handling to cause excessive allocation leading to…
description: A security vulnerability in the wso2am package allows a pre-authentication attacker to exploit improper type size/count handling, causing excessive memory allocation that can lead to denial of service. This issue affects versions prior to 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4. A fix is available in these versions.
